rules.name: Dispute Creation Trigger
rules.statement: A Dispute Ticket must be created immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception or missing items.
rules.condition: when a delivery proof indicates a delivery exception or missing items
rules.if_violated: the delivery exception is not formally tracked, preventing accurate financial settlement and customer support
rules.rationale: ensures every delivery exception is captured for resolution and financial adjustment

rules.name: Refund Initiation Gate
rules.statement: A refund must be initiated only after a Dispute Ticket is marked as validated or a delivery failure is explicitly confirmed.
rules.condition: when a refund is requested for a specific order
rules.if_violated: funds are returned prematurely or incorrectly, causing revenue loss and inventory reconciliation errors
rules.rationale: prevents unauthorized financial adjustments before the root cause and liability are established

rules.name: Self-Approval Prohibition
rules.statement: An actor must not approve a Dispute Ticket where they are the accused party or the party responsible for the alleged failure.
rules.condition: when an actor is assigned to approve a Dispute Ticket
rules.if_violated: conflict of interest compromises the integrity of the dispute resolution process and invites fraud
rules.rationale: ensures impartial adjudication of disputes by separating the accused from the decision-maker

rules.name: SLA Escalation Threshold
rules.statement: Unresolved Dispute Tickets must be escalated to a Fulfillment Supervisor after the initial assignment deadline expires.
rules.condition: when a Dispute Ticket remains in 'Open' status beyond the initial assignment deadline
rules.if_violated: resolution delays increase customer dissatisfaction and breach service level agreements
rules.rationale: ensures timely resolution of stale disputes to maintain customer trust and operational efficiency

parameters.name: initial_assignment_deadline
parameters.description: maximum time allowed for initial assignment before escalation
